from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, time, sys, signal, struct
state=Path(__file__).parent

sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'scripts'))
from sync_runs import RunArchive, publish
serial='100.76.86.48:5555'
pkg='com.waterui.example.map'
def adb(*args,timeout=30):
    return subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s',serial,*args],timeout=timeout)
def text(*args): return adb(*args).decode().strip()
def stop(*args): raise SystemExit('device deadline reached')
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop)
build=json.loads((state/'2537-pan-current-build.json').read_text())
metadata={'device':{'model':text('shell','getprop','ro.product.model'),'model_identifier':text('shell','getprop','ro.product.device'),'os':'Android '+text('shell','getprop','ro.build.version.release'),'gpu':'Mali-G715'},'source':{'revision':build['revision']},'configuration':{'measurement_kind':'real-map-pan-diagnostic','cache_policy':'existing application and driver caches preserved; not cold installation','instrumentation':'unmodified dev, four alternating horizontal swipes; frame-lowered logs, no speedup or p99 claim'}}
journal=RunArchive(out/'journal',metadata)
backups=[]
for i,line in enumerate(text('shell','pm','path',pkg).splitlines()):
    p=out/f'previous-{i}.apk'
    adb('pull',line.removeprefix('package:'),str(p),timeout=60)
    backups.append(str(p))
previous_timeout=text('shell','settings','get','system','screen_off_timeout')
awake='mWakefulness=Awake' in text('shell','dumpsys','power')
installed=False
try:
    adb('shell','settings','put','system','screen_off_timeout','300000')
    adb('shell','input','keyevent','KEYCODE_WAKEUP')
    adb('shell','wm','dismiss-keyguard')
    result=text('install','-r','-d',build['apk'])
    if 'Success' not in result: raise RuntimeError(result)
    installed=True
    for index in range(1):
        run=out/f'r{index}';run.mkdir()
        adb('shell','am','force-stop',pkg)
        started=time.time()
        adb('shell','am','start','-W','-n',pkg+'/.MainActivity','--es','waterui.log.level','DEBUG')
        pid=text('shell','pidof',pkg)
        ready=False
        deadline=time.monotonic()+90
        log=''
        try:
            while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                log=adb('logcat','-d','-v','epoch','--pid='+pid).decode(errors='replace')
                if 'panic at ' in log: raise RuntimeError('map process panicked')
                if 'activated prepared GPU map' in log and 'frame presented' in log.split('activated prepared GPU map')[-1]:
                    ready=True
                    break
                time.sleep(1)
            if not ready: raise TimeoutError('map activation and presentation not observed')
            time.sleep(3)
            (run/'initial.png').write_bytes(adb('exec-out','screencap','-p'))
            (run/'memory.txt').write_bytes(adb('shell','dumpsys','meminfo',pkg))
            events=[]
            for pan,(x1,x2) in enumerate([(750,250),(250,750),(750,250),(250,750)]):
                events.append({'pan':pan,'start_epoch':time.time(),'from':[x1,1100],'to':[x2,1100],'duration_ms':600})
                adb('shell','input','swipe',str(x1),'1100',str(x2),'1100','600')
                events[-1]['input_end_epoch']=time.time()
                time.sleep(3)
                (run/f'pan-{pan}.png').write_bytes(adb('exec-out','screencap','-p'))
                events[-1]['settled_epoch']=time.time()
                (run/'events.json').write_text(json.dumps(events,indent=2))
            (run/'final-memory.txt').write_bytes(adb('shell','dumpsys','meminfo',pkg))
        finally:
            log=adb('logcat','-d','-v','epoch','--pid='+pid).decode(errors='replace')
            (run/'app.log').write_text(log)
            lines=log.splitlines()
            for chunk_index in range(0,len(lines),250):
                report=run/f'part-{chunk_index//250}.json'
                width,height=struct.unpack('>II',(run/'initial.png').read_bytes()[16:24]) if (run/'initial.png').exists() else (None,None)
                data={'width':width,'height':height,'engine':'cherenkov','scene':'real-map-first-process','samples':[],'completed':ready,'launch_epoch':started,'round':index,'log':lines[chunk_index:chunk_index+250]}
                if chunk_index==0:
                    data['runner_source']=Path(__file__).read_text()
                    data['events']=json.loads((run/'events.json').read_text()) if (run/'events.json').exists() else []
                    data['final_memory']=(run/'final-memory.txt').read_text() if (run/'final-memory.txt').exists() else None
                    data['instrumentation_patch']='No source instrumentation.'
                    if (run/'memory.txt').exists(): data['process_memory']=(run/'memory.txt').read_text()
                report.write_text(json.dumps(data))
                journal.record(report,{},valid=False,reason='First-process attribution diagnostic; network/cache state not controlled for cross-run speedup comparisons.')
finally:
    try:
        if installed:
            adb('shell','am','force-stop',pkg)
            if backups:
                result=adb('install' if len(backups)==1 else 'install-multiple','-r','-d',*backups,timeout=120).decode()
                if 'Success' not in result: raise RuntimeError('application restore failed: '+result)
        if previous_timeout=='null': adb('shell','settings','delete','system','screen_off_timeout')
        else: adb('shell','settings','put','system','screen_off_timeout',previous_timeout)
        if not awake: adb('shell','input','keyevent','KEYCODE_SLEEP')
    finally:
        publish(journal.directory,repo)
